title: Executing JavaScript ⚙️
ques: Write a line of code in Selenium to execute a JavaScript snippet that scrolls the page to the very bottom.
explanation: Injecting JS via `execute_script` is essential for handling infinite scrolling and interacting with hidden elements.

title: Waiting for Dynamic Elements ⏳
ques: Use Selenium's `WebDriverWait` to wait up to 10 seconds for an element with ID `content` to become visible.

answer.content:
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By

element = WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(
    EC.visibility_of_element_located((By.ID, 'content'))
)

explanation: Explicit waits pause execution until a specific condition is met, preventing errors caused by elements taking time to load.

title: Switching to iframes 🖼
ques: Write the Selenium command to switch the driver's focus into an iframe that has the ID `'payment-frame'`.
explanation: Elements inside an `iframe` belong to a different document context and cannot be accessed until you switch into that frame.
